# V18.4 analysis choices

Recorded before computing new Val32 or external control scores.

- Reuse the saved H1 300,000 row indices and identical Val32 valid Q pixels. The five primary models are M1, M3, C1, C2 and C3. Preserve original unpenalized intercept and Train-only standardization. Main alpha 1, sensitivity alpha 0.1, 10 and 100 as in V18.2. Save M0 and M2 alpha-1 coefficients/rank as ancillary four-arm references. No tuning.
- C1: 20 seeds 184101 through 184120 inclusive. SeedSequence([seed, role_code, integer_frame_id]), Train code 1 and Val code 2. Draw 8 independent standard normal features at every row-major Q location, then select training/evaluation rows. Report every replicate and the per-frame arithmetic mean of the 20 seed-specific Spearman coefficients as C1_mean20. Its bootstrap conditions on the 20 fixed seeds, while replicate variation is reported separately.
- C2: z = original 17 M1 inputs standardized on the exact sampled Train rows. Use 50,000 uniformly drawn distinct-index pairs from those rows (repeated pairs allowed), NumPy RNG seed 184201. Median of squared Euclidean distances m. Set gamma = 1/(2m) for k(z,z') = exp(-gamma*||z-z'||^2). Draw W_ij ~ N(0,2gamma) and b_j ~ Uniform(0,2pi) using seed 184202. Use sqrt(2/8)*cos(zW+b), then Train-only per-column standardization as in the original Ridge readout. Reuse the mapping in every evaluation dataset.
- C3: base seed 184301, SeedSequence([base_seed, role_code, ...ASCII frame ID bytes]). Role codes Train=1, Val=2, KITTI=3, ETH3D=4. Permute full row-major Q before taking valid or sampled rows. One vector permutation for all eight channels, independently by image and role. Reuse a view's same permutation for both ETH3D endpoints. Full-image joint feature distribution is preserved, a masked subset's distribution need not be.
- Development bootstrap: 10,000 equal-frame paired percentile resamples with replacement, seed 184401. Reuse identical draws for all arm contrasts and alpha settings. Marginal 95% intervals, descriptive conditional on the frame sample and existing known sequence association. No significance-based selection.
- Coverage: thresholds 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, fixed A geometry, identical four arms. Use the original sampled Q rows at each threshold when all remain eligible. If a stricter mask removes rows, reselect 300,000 using the original seeded pooled-valid rule (all if fewer). If only new pixels are eligible, retain original selection to isolate the evaluation change and disclose that scope. Compute projected supervision first, use label-free DPS Q on eligible rows. No threshold selection.
- External: alpha-1 M1/M3 from V18 saved scores as reference. Freeze C2/C3 Train readouts and transforms. KITTI original mask, ETH3D both endpoints. Use cached float32 feature arrays for the new controls with saved float64 model scores as reference. Check rounding sensitivity by recomputing M1/M3 on cached features. Cluster-aware paired bootstrap is descriptive, 10,000 draws, seed 184402, KITTI scene IDs and ETH3D seven families. C1 stays a development placebo.

# V18.4 recurrent query control

The source-specific candidate domains are the entire I3 and I4 slices. An equal-budget mask restricted to the corresponding source is unique and cannot be randomized. The combined per-level query is a separate comparison domain, supporting a count-matched mixed-source program control. It can test whether a coherent source mask behaves differently from an arbitrary mixed mask, conditional on achieved removal strength. It cannot identify an effect of positions within an individual source.

Before new forwards, fix the feasibility procedure. Use the first Val32 frame in the existing manifest as the feasibility frame. If the procedure can produce initial-query masks within 5% relative removed L2 per level for all 20 seeds and both interventions, perform an exploratory comparison on the first four Val32 frames, in manifest order. The four-frame scope limits new forwards and supplies a mechanism probe rather than a full Val32 validation. Report all requested seeds and any failed control. No labels or residual ranks are used to select masks.

Seeds 184501–184520. For each seed, frame, level and program, draw 4,096 uniform nine-channel sets without replacement within each set from the 261 channels. Require at least five of nine channels from the geometric slice. For I3 remove the chosen nine. For I4 keep the chosen nine, removing their 252-channel complement. This ensures at least five swaps relative to the real program. Keep the set fixed over all recurrent calls. Choose the candidate minimizing the difference between its removed L2 norm and the real mask's norm on the common first query. Ties use the earliest draw. Counts match separately by level. The label-free 5% first-query rule tests whether a meaningful starting match is available, before calculating random-arm predictions. Later recurrence can change the removed norms. Report per-call L2 for real and random, and do not call an exploratory result strength-matched unless at least 90% of level/call pairs per replicate are within 10%. The pilot feasibility does not establish matching in other frames.

Use the H2 cached ordinary and actual I3/I4 outputs, and reproduce the real restricted output when instrumenting the query for norms. Use absolute disparity change on candidate A and the original common Val32 residual target. The proposed comparison is the single-intervention magnitude Spearman and its paired difference against the randomized program. No Ridge fitting, no target use in channel selection, and no random control for I1/I2.

Implementation note before any randomized forward: the historical restricted replay differed materially in both local Torch environments. The first query still met the prespecified count and norm feasibility rule. To avoid mixing inference runs, repeat the fixed four-frame comparison within the same current Torch runtime. Generate one new ordinary output per frame and share it between all real and random branches. Preserve the historical replay differences and the baseline replay differences. Keep the scope, masks, seeds, ranking target and matching thresholds above. Interpret this as a separate exploratory probe.
